item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 11/Dec/2021
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A replenishment of the northeast monsoon will reach the coast of Guangdong tomorrow night, and will bring cool weather to the region. With the monsoon moderating gradually midweek next week, temperatures over Guangdong will rise slightly. Another surge of the northeast monsoon will affect southern China in the latter part of next week. Besides, a tropical cyclone will form over the western North Pacific next week, and will move in the general direction of the vicinity of the Philippines.
